reviews.review:
Mass Effect Andromeda is not all bad like people say, but it is a step down from original mass effect trilogy. Lets talk about pros and cons of the game

Let talk about pros
-Characters in this game are fun and rememberable
-Story had some epic moment 
-Side quest was not cookie cutter just like in ubisoft games
-Plenty of new gear and weapons can be unlocked  by playing the game
-Enemy AI is really responsive if playing on higher difficulty
-Beautiful graphics and amazing scenery  

Lets talk about cons 
-As mass effect game it lacks making hard choices. Some choices dose not even impact the world, story or even characters around you.
-Going to tempest is really annoying, because it plays animation of Tempest flying to orbit.
-Lack ground battle with Nomad.
-Still has funny glitches in cutscene and flickering is super annoying
-Bosses in the games are recycled alot, The game has only three major bosses.

What Andromeda should have done
-Let us play the role of pathfinder as any race as we like krogan, Asari, Turian or even Salarian
-Lets us upgrade and customize squad gear
-Add ground battle with nomad just like mass effect 1 or batman Arkham Night
-add more species instead of focusing on Kett and Angarian only. 
-Use different types of wild life on different planets instead of copying same wild life from planet to planet

So, a quite flawed, but still enjoyable game - one that suffers in comparison to the originals 7/10.  *short version*

Long Version -

Andromeda shows all the flaws of a rushed release that resulted from them junking the prior iteration and being forced to get anything out the door by the corporate stooges at EA.  While it does a bit of everything, it does it all poorly, and the obsession with the multi-player (which of course has microtransactions, and was supported for a full year past single player) is probably the biggest tell.  Crafting is lackluster, despite how almost 1/3 of the unlockable talents contribute to it.  Single player storylines cut off abruptly, or are never mentioned by the characters affected.
The characters are take it or leave it, not engendering either hate or love.  The dialogue has been rendered meaningless, taking out any feeling of actually being involved in the game ending or evolution.  The lack of Paragon/Renegade ties into this as well.  And casting the lead as an irreverent late teen/early 20 something is a choice that baffles me:  are they trying to only appeal to a new fanbase?  Because if you're been playing the entire trilogy, this is likely not your age group.  
Okay, let's get to a few things I did like.  I enjoy a return to a more ME1 style skill based system, where your build isn't just "what order do I max out these 4 skills" even if I don't like the limitation to the 3 active skills.  I like the option to have mid air battles and increased freedom of movement.  I feel that the worlds are gorgeous, making me want to explore them more than the game calls for.  I like the return of the Mako (even without weapons).  

So back to the short version.

So, a quite flawed, but still enjoyable game - one that suffers in comparison to the originals 7/10.

I got it at 14.99 on sale.  I CERTAINLY wouldn't have been have given a positive review if I had paid $60, and probably wouldn't at 29.99 (the current price).  So get it if it's on a deep sale, and you can stand the !@#$%^&*() mandatory Origin overlay - Which if I allowed to affect my review of the GAME would make me drop it to 5/10 or less.

This game is pretty "Mass Effect"-alike game with pretty deep flaws. The story-telling is flat and you wont get hooked into it. The main plot feels a bit shallow and empty. Still its a mass effect game with some new features regarding the "old" trillogy. For 10-15€ worth. You'll get under the magic 1€ per hour benchmark quite easy with this one. Multiple playthroughs like on the old ones? I don't think so.

Treat this game like its own new game not tied to the other 3. Im 13 hours in and its great so far!! Fantastic open world sci fi game with good mechanics, good level design, good gaphics and the story is not bad either. Loving it.
